# Leaf Envy

> Premium online retailer specializing in indoor plants, houseplants, decorative pots, and plant care accessories with curated collections for every skill level and living space.

Leaf Envy offers a comprehensive selection of live and artificial houseplants, designer planters, and plant accessories. The site features curated collections organized by plant characteristics (low-light, pet-friendly, air-purifying), difficulty level, and size, alongside pre-paired plant-and-pot combinations and gift bundles.

## Main Collections

- [Leaf Envy | Indoor Plants & Pots](https://www.leafenvy.co.uk): Homepage showcasing indoor plants, pots, and delivery guarantees
- [Indoor Plants for Your Home | Premium Houseplants](https://www.leafenvy.co.uk/collections/indoor-plants): Main collection of premium houseplants including Pothos, Anthurium, and Palm
- [Bestselling Plants | Buy Plants Online | Leaf Envy](https://www.leafenvy.co.uk/collections/best-sellers-1): Top-selling plants including Kentia Palm, Monstera, and Snake Plant
- [Large Plants](https://www.leafenvy.co.uk/collections/large-plants-1): Large houseplants including Kentia Palm, Rubber Plant, and Bird of Paradise

## Plant Categories by Characteristics

- [Hard To Kill | Low Maintenance Indoor Plants & Houseplants for Delivery by Leaf Envy](https://www.leafenvy.co.uk/collections/hard-to-kill): Low-maintenance houseplants for beginners including Monstera and Snake Plant
- [Pet Friendly Indoor Plants | Leaf Envy](https://www.leafenvy.co.uk/collections/pet-friendly): Non-toxic houseplants safe for pets including Spider Plant and Kentia Palm
- [Air Purifying Indoor Plants & Houseplants for Delivery by Leaf Envy](https://www.leafenvy.co.uk/collections/air-purifying): Air-purifying houseplants including Kentia Palm and Monstera Deliciosa
- [Low Light Indoor Plants | Plants for Dark Rooms](https://www.leafenvy.co.uk/collections/low-light): Shade-tolerant plants for low-light spaces including Pothos and ZZ Plant
- [Flowering House Plants](https://www.leafenvy.co.uk/collections/flowering-house-plants): Flowering houseplants including Peace Lily, Orchids, and Anthurium
